def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    # find anomalous hole: cells whose vertical mirror differs, clustered
    # assume hole = contiguous block of a color (3) not appearing as mirror-consistent
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    # background = most common; find the hole as largest connected region where g[i][j]!=g[H-1-i][j]
    bad=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=g[H-1-i][j]]
    print(len(bad))
    # restrict to the hole block: rows of bad cluster
    if not bad: return g
    is_=[i for i,j in bad]; js=[j for i,j in bad]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(is_),max(is_),min(js),max(js)
    out=[[g[H-1-i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H=len(g)
    bad=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]!=g[H-1-i][j]]
    is_=[i for i,j in bad]; js=[j for i,j in bad]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(is_),max(is_),min(js),max(js)
    # hole = the half of the bbox where one color dominates; pick cells of the hole color (minority appearing once in pair)
    vals=[g[i][j] for i,j in bad]
    holeval=Counter(g[i][j] for i,j in bad).most_common()
    # choose cells whose color count in bad region is smaller (hole color), take bbox of those
    ccount=Counter(vals)
    hv=min(ccount, key=lambda v:ccount[v])
    cells=[(i,j) for i,j in bad if g[i][j]==hv]
    r0,r1=min(i for i,j in cells),max(i for i,j in cells)
    c0,c1=min(j for i,j in cells),max(j for i,j in cells)
    return [[g[H-1-i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
